name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
how_to_apply: Check eligibility on the official PM-JAY portal (Am I Eligible) or the Ayushman App, then generate the Ayushman card.
notes: Covered procedures are the author's selection of common hospital-stay procedures and were not re-verified one by one against the official package list. Outpatient scans and tests are not matched to this scheme. The age 70 and above Ayushman Vay Vandana card is not modelled.

name: Rajiv Aarogyasri (Telangana)
how_to_apply: Verify eligibility on the Aarogyasri portal or through the health department, with Aadhaar and the white ration card.
notes: Covered procedures are the author's selection of common hospital-stay procedures and were not re-verified one by one against the official package list. The Rs 10 lakh per family per year limit is taken from published scheme summaries.
